title: India registered nearly 3 lakh electric cars in Jan-Oct 2026 (Vahan; GaadiWaadi 2,93,877 with data to 4 Nov; Autocar India's quarterly figures sum to about 2.94 lakh), against just under 2 lakh in all of 2025 (Autocar India 1,95,571; Frost & Sullivan via IBEF). Autocar India counts 3,04,701 from 1 Jan to 9 Nov, which it calls the first calendar year above 3 lakh, and expects 3.5-3.6 lakh by 31 Dec. Shares: Tata 39.7%, Mahindra about 23% (now No. 2, overtaking JSW MG), JSW MG 18.7%, VinFast about 5%; top three about 81%.
